name: @avatark/runtime-bridge
description: Renderer-neutral RuntimeBridge protocol (schemaVersion 1.0): the contract between a renderer runtime and the AvatarK Platform Runtime Ingress. Protocol, local state machine, validation, JSON Schema, conformance fixtures. Not a lifecycle authority; no networking, credentials or URLs (transport is injected).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
